**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Inspect nested power-need unknowns before suppressing research**

When a Signal has accepted activity evidence, `project_state()` marks the top-level `power_need` as `SUPPORTED` even if its nested MW, duration, timing, or supply fields are `UNKNOWN`. If lifecycle, activity, and utility are also supported, this comprehension produces an empty `missing_facts` list, so `research_recommended()` returns false despite the material commercial inputs that deep enrichment is intended to resolve. Include unknown/conflicting nested power-need fields in the missing-fact calculation.
